name: thepapers-niw
description: U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) skills for DIY self-petitioners and immigration professionals. niw-evaluate gives an honest pre-filing assessment under the Dhanasar three-prong framework. niw-package-review reads an assembled package as a skeptical adjudicator would and returns a prioritized fix list and a readiness verdict. niw-rfe-response works a Request for Evidence or Notice of Intent to Deny from the printed deadline through a drafted response, holding the rules that decide them: eligibility is fixed at the filing date and the proposed endeavor may not be re-scoped to fit the notice. Legal substance is published in knowledge/ and distilled from the complete public pool of 1,040 AAO non-precedent NIW decisions issued 2025-01 through 2026-06.
displayName: NIW Skills by The Papers Company
